visual_review: The four Blender stills show both runs. The two entrance views show uninterrupted wood at both rail tips and elbows, iron uprights inside the stone ledges, and feet seated on the stringers. The three retained Quest door and landing photographs in files_sha256 document the previous stairwell revision.
rail_contact: Each flight has 18 raked balusters and four landing posts. The side masonry starts at |x| = 1.15 m, leaving at least 78 mm to the posts and 20 mm to the widest brackets. The threshold anchors tie both stringers to the threshold. Each raked post lower cap sits at least 28.6 mm inside its stringer. Each walnut rail extends 85 mm before the first post and continues through a shared miter ring at the landing. All 352 outward rays from the actual exported iron cap vertices encounter the enclosing wood per flight.
rear_door: Hinged leaf, pull and sign move with named DoorPivot. Leaf clears each jamb by 2 mm; lintel underside sits 5 mm above the closed leaf. Side and cap liner start at z=4.815, behind the front wood plane at z=4.75. Closed leaf spans z=4.825..4.915 and meets the landing height. Black sill begins at z=4.935, 20 mm behind the leaf, overlaps the landing by 15 mm and sits 1 mm above it. Wall sides and horizontal infill meet at x=+/-0.645 m; rear black panel overlaps the cap.
door_clearance: Blender evaluated world-space BVH checks of moving leaf meshes against jambs, rear wall, lintel and recess at closed and 5-degree increments through 75 degrees. Jambs terminate at the lintel underside.
surface_contact: Each riser is a vertical face 3 mm behind its tread boundary (z=0.913+0.34i) without horizontal caps. Ascending supports begin 6 mm behind the boundary. Threshold ends z=0.91, treads span z=0.91+0.34i to 1.25+0.34i, and landing begins z=3.97.
preview_provenance: Blender 5.3.0 EEVEE rendered four 1000 × 700 stills from the packed rail candidate. The central views show the open doorway. The oblique entrance views show both complete handrails and their masonry clearances.
frame_overlap_regression: The previous export fails: the front ray at x=-0.615 and landing+0.7 hits both wood and black at the same depth. Current export passes 15 front and oblique frame-versus-liner rays per flight.
sill_regression: The previous GLB fails the tracked sill check at z=4.76 where the black recess covers the landing. The current export samples wood through z=4.93 and black at z=4.94, 5.0 and 5.5 on both flights.
rail_regression: The original exported post caps reached 62 mm past the inner face of the side stone. The previous front tips left iron cap vertices exposed. Both contacts are checked on GLB reimport. Two independent Blender builds produced the same GLB SHA-256. All seven material definitions, nine embedded image hashes and four door pivot or handle transforms match the previous GLB.
